messages:
Emma P (Partnerships): FYI — Marketplace SDK v3 will remove support for `legacyAuth` next release (effective 2026-05-15). Need partner coordination + pinning policy for marketplace listings. Who can own partner comms?
Maria P (Product): Do we have a definitive list of impacted partners? Any legal/regulatory flags yet?
Emma P (Partnerships): Initial hits: CloudCo, InfraHub, ApexSI — they all use the legacyAuth flow in our marketplace connectors. I can start outreach but need SDK migration guidance and recommended timeline to share.
Ron E (Eng): This is a breaking change. Recommend a 6-week deprecation window + runtime toggle `LEGACY_AUTH_COMPAT` for hosted/dedicated to give partners time. Also propose a marketplace pin policy: listings must declare supported SDK major (e.g., `>=3.x`) or opt into compatibility flag.
Alex S (SDK): I'll add a deprecation warning at import time and a preflight checker that surfaces incompatible usage on install. Example migration snippet to include in the doc:
```
# replace legacyAuth with OAuth token flow
client = RedwoodClient(auth=OAuth(token="<TOKEN>"), model="...")
```
I'll open a PR for the checker + migration guide today.
Sophie S (Security): Please confirm persisted tokens and telemetry are handled — some partners are in regulated verticals. If partners need to re-issue creds, we should aim for a short deadline (45 days) and provide an automated migration script.
Maria P (Product): For marketplace operations I want a simple badge and enforcement rule: manifest must have `sdk_support: ">=3.1"` or `compat_flag: true`. Marketing will want a migration checklist and sample code snippets for each partner.
Emma P (Partnerships): Proposed timeline: 
```
- Week 0 (today): partner notify + migration doc published
- Week 2: SDK preflight warning live + marketplace badge available
- Week 4: hosted default flips to disallow legacyAuth (toggle still exists)
- Week 6: compatibility toggle removed; marketplace enforcement enabled
```
Alex S (SDK): I'll add a CI gate on marketplace manifests that warns/fails if `sdk_support` pins a major < 3.1. Target: PR by EOD Wed.
Ron E (Eng): Ops note: for Dedicated & Private we should keep the toggle around for +90 days but mark as deprecated in the runbook. I'll draft runbook steps for rollback and emergency re-enable.
Emma P (Partnerships): Action items (owners + dates):
- Emma: assemble partner email list & notify by EOD today
- Alex: PR for preflight checker + manifest CI by Wed (1775080000)
- Ron: ops runbook + private policy doc by Fri
- Sophie: compliance review & sign-off within 3 business days
- Maria: draft marketplace badge + marketing cadence (coordinate with marketing)

deploy-bot: Shared migration doc: https://redwood.example.com/docs/marketplace/legacyAuth-migration (uploaded)
Maria P (Product): +1 on cadence. I'll sync with marketing for partner webinars and sample config. :loudspeaker: 
Emma P (Partnerships): Thanks — I'll cc partners on the draft and track responses in the partner tracker.
Alex S (SDK): One more ask — can partnerships push for partner test windows? A staging flip would help catch edge cases.
Emma P (Partnerships): Yep — will ask partners for a staging cutoff date in the outreach.
Sophie S (Security): If anyone touches token handling, add me to PR review.
Ron E (Eng): Noted.
Emma P (Partnerships): Good progress. I'll follow up after the PRs land and update this thread.
